subject: CloudVera renewal kickoff — term alignment, throughput test & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@cloudvera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: CloudVera renewal kickoff — term alignment, throughput test & QBR scheduling

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, I wanted to kick off the renewal / expansion conversation in one thread so we can track timelines and owners. High-level items we covered and next steps below.

Summary of asks from CloudVera
- Move from a 12-month to a 24-month term (targeting lower unit pricing).
- Uplift committed throughput ~2x across the same model suite (production begins at renewal start).
- Run a short throughput/stress validation before renewal to validate sizing and warm caches.
- Procurement will need SOW + pricing and our standard security addendum.

Proposed timeline
- Week of Aug 24: QBR to align executive stakeholders + confirm final term/pricing. (I listed some proposed slots below.)
- Aug 31–Sep 2: Throughput validation window (canary run + load profile).
- Sep 8: Final SOW sent for signature (aiming to have DocuSign out by then).

Immediate next steps (owners)
- Redwood: circulate SOW draft (attached) and test plan (attached) — Irene / Marissa.
- CloudVera: confirm which team will own the stress test and share the internal schedule — Lisa / Ops.
- Procurement: send any required PO or template / contract redlines early so we can ingest — Procurement contact.

QBR slot proposals (PT)
- Tue Aug 25 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Aug 26 08:00–09:00 PT
- Thu Aug 27 14:00–15:00 PT

Attachments included: CloudVera_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (SOW + pricing table), throughput-test-plan.md (draft test plan).

If those slots won't work, happy to use your calendar poll.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

—
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@cloudvera.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudVera Ops <ops@cloudvera.com>, CloudVera Procurement <procurement@cloudvera.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudVera renewal kickoff — term alignment, throughput test & QBR scheduling

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the clear summary. We are aligned on the 24-month preference and the 2x throughput target — that looks appropriate given our roadmap. A few quick items from our side:

- Procurement asked that we share any standard SLAs tied to the 24-month term and an initial price table by EOD Friday so they can circulate internally.
- Ops can own the throughput run but would like a one-week prep window with your infra/solutions team to finalize test harness and traffic profiles.
- We can do a QBR on Tue Aug 25 10:00 PT — that slot works best for our execs.

Attached: CloudVera_internal_sched.xlsx (internal availability and procurement timeline).

One question: can the stress test be scoped as a non-production canary that mirrors our peak hour profile (we don't want cache eviction on production nodes)? If so, Ops will target Aug 31–Sep 2 as proposed.

I'll await the updated SOW with the 24-month pricing and the test plan with specific endpoints/keys to use.

Thanks,
Lisa
Director of Platform Engineering, CloudVera
lisa.nguyen@cloudvera.com | +1 (206) 555-0893

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@cloudvera.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudVera renewal kickoff — term alignment, throughput test & QBR scheduling

Thanks Lisa / Irene — looping Marissa and the pricing folks into this thread (cc'ed). Quick internal notes for alignment before the QBR:

1) Pricing & term:
- 24-month term pricing model: propose a stepped discount schedule — 10% Y1, 12% Y2 off list for committed throughput at 2x.
- We should prepare a short slide with list vs committed per-token economics for the QBR (Ben will take lead).

2) SOW redlines:
- I'll incorporate the 24-month term and create an explicit acceptance criteria section for the throughput validation (so procurement signs off on performance gating).
- Requesting the CloudVera PO template if procurement needs it early (Lisa mentioned that).

3) Throughput test ops:
- We recommend a 48–72 hour window with pre-warm (24h) + two 12-hour ramp cycles to simulate sustained peak.
- Need a short runbook for failover & rollback; Kimberly can own that doc and a dedicated Slack channel for the test.

Action items before Tue QBR:
- Ben: draft two-slide pricing comparison (list vs committed 24mo).
- Marissa: update SOW with performance gating & attach redline.
- Kimberly: draft runbook template and propose test Slack channel name.
- Irene: send updated SOW + DocuSign link by EOD Wed.

I'll be on the QBR and can jump to pricing discussion.

—
Marissa Cole
Renewal Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0077

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@cloudvera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, CloudVera Procurement <procurement@cloudvera.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudVera renewal kickoff — term alignment, throughput test & QBR scheduling

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick replies. Confirming next steps and calendar invites:

- QBR: Tue Aug 25, 10:00–11:00 PT — invite sent to execs and primary stakeholders. Agenda: 10m overview, 20m pricing & term, 20m technical validation plan, 10m decisions & next steps.
- Throughput validation window: Aug 31 00:00 PT — Sep 2 23:59 PT (we'll do a 24h pre-warm starting Aug 31 then the ramp cycles on Sep 1). Kimberly will post the runbook and Slack channel by Aug 24.
- SOW: attached updated SOW (CloudVera_SOW_draft_v1.pdf) — I've updated term language to 24 months and added a performance gating section. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123456789 (I will route to procurement after QBR).

Ben/Marissa: please confirm the price slides are ready by EOD Mon so I can attach them to the QBR pack.

Lisa: if procurement has any required contract language, please share before the QBR so we can surface redlines.

Thanks — looking forward to the QBR.

—
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
